name: Lennox International
tagline: Global leader in heating, ventilation, air conditioning, and refrigeration solutions for residential and commercial markets
hero_kpi_rationale: Home Comfort Solutions est le plus gros segment de Lennox (près des deux tiers du chiffre d'affaires) et capte la demande du CVC résidentiel américain, marché dominé par le remplacement. Ses ventes reflètent directement la dynamique cœur de métier, là où le total consolidé masque le mix résidentiel et commercial.

kpis.short: Home Comfort Solutions unit sales volume growth
kpis.name_fr: Croissance des volumes unitaires Home Comfort Solutions
kpis.signal: Volumes residentiels en fort recul sous destockage et transition refrigerant, amelioration sequentielle attendue.

kpis.short: Building Climate Solutions organic revenue growth
kpis.name_fr: Croissance organique du chiffre d'affaires Building Climate Solutions
kpis.signal: Segment commercial en croissance organique soutenue par emergency replacement et gains de comptes nationaux.
Levier prix/mix cle pour compenser l'inflation et le recul des volumes, tire par la transition R454B.

kpis.short: Record full-year segment margin, above 20% for the first time in company history
kpis.name_fr: Marge de segment annuelle record, au-dessus de 20% pour la premiere fois
kpis.signal: Jalon structurel: premiere annee de l'histoire au-dessus de 20% de marge, malgre tarifs et inflation, preuve de la resilience du modele.

kpis.short: Annual revenue of the Durodyne and Subco acquisitions
kpis.name_fr: Chiffre d'affaires annuel des acquisitions Durodyne et Subco
kpis.signal: Acquisition d'environ 550 M$ qui accelere le levier pieces et accessoires sur les deux segments, relutive des 2026.

kpis.short: Commercial services business more than doubled over the past three years
kpis.name_fr: Chiffre d'affaires du service commercial multiplie par plus de deux en trois ans
kpis.signal: Preuve de la strategie full lifecycle: le service commercial a plus que double, relais de marge et de fidelisation des grands comptes.
300 M$ investis depuis 2022 pour elargir les capacites et renforcer la position concurrentielle, benefices encore en debut de materialisation.

kpis.short: Cost productivity delivered in the year
kpis.name_fr: Productivite et actions de couts delivrees sur l'annee
kpis.signal: Plus de 75 M$ de productivite livres en 2025 pour absorber inflation et tarifs, avec cible identique reconduite pour 2026.

kpis.short: Duro Dyne and Supco acquisition net purchase price
kpis.signal: Plus grosse acquisition depuis des annees, portefeuille de pieces et fournitures CVC reparti entre residentiel (Supco) et commercial (Duro Dyne), finance par tresorerie et nouveau term loan de 300 M$.
Dividende trimestriel releve de 1,15 a 1,30 $ par action (+13%) a compter du versement de juillet 2025, signal de confiance dans la generation de cash.

risks.title: Competition in the HVACR business
risks.score_rationale: Competition is mentioned first in the risk factors, indicating primary management concern. The HVACR industry is capital and scale-intensive, directly impacting pricing power and market share. Citation: "Business Overview We operate in two reportable business segments of the HVACR industry, Home Comfort". Position: haut Item 1A.
risks.summary: Intense competition in the HVACR sector can constrain pricing and market share, particularly in residential and light commercial segments.

risks.title: Volatility of raw material prices and significant supply interruptions
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly detailed in MD&A with specific commodities mentioned (steel, aluminum, copper). 2025 financials show 160 bps margin impact from higher product costs and 120 bps from freight, demonstrating materiality. Citation: "We seek to mitigate the impact of certain commodity price volatility through a combination of". Position: haut Item 1A.
risks.summary: Fluctuations in steel, aluminum, and copper prices combined with supply chain disruptions increase production costs and operational uncertainty.

risks.title: Dependence on customer demand and general economic conditions
risks.score_rationale: MD&A emphasizes that demand is influenced by new construction, interest rates, financing availability, and consumer confidence. 13% volume decline in 2025 demonstrates cyclical vulnerability. Citation: "In addition to weather, demand for our products and services is influenced by national and". Position: haut Item 1A.
risks.summary: Business performance is highly dependent on new construction activity levels and macroeconomic conditions including interest rates and consumer spending.

risks.title: Product liability, warranty claims, recalls, and litigation risks
risks.score_rationale: MD&A references $10.9M in environmental liabilities and special litigation charges for 2025, including asbestos-related litigation and facility remediation costs. Citation: "Refer to Note 5 in the Notes to the Consolidated Financial Statements for more information". Position: milieu Item 1A.
risks.summary: Ongoing litigation exposure including asbestos claims and environmental liabilities require provisions and contingent liability management.

risks.title: Cyber attacks and information systems disruptions
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly identified in forward-looking statements as cyber attack risk. Standard risk for technology-dependent industrial manufacturers with distribution networks. Citation: "We generated $758 million of cash flow from operating activities in 2025 compared to $946". Position: haut Item 1A.
risks.summary: Cyber attacks and information system disruptions could impair operations, compromise data security, and damage customer relationships.

risks.title: Ability to attract, motivate, develop and retain employees
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly mentioned in risk factors. MD&A notes 2025 benefited from 'reduced incentive compensation,' indicating labor market management challenges. Citation: "AES is a company dedicated to service and sustainability in the light commercial markets across". Position: haut Item 1A.
risks.summary: Success depends on recruiting and retaining qualified employees in technical and manufacturing roles amid competitive labor markets.

risks.title: Changes in environmental, climate, and tax legislation
risks.score_rationale: One Big Beautiful Bill Act enacted July 4, 2025, with future fiscal impacts. Climate regulations increasingly impact HVAC efficiency standards and product requirements. Citation: "Foreign currency exchange losses increased in 2024 primarily due to changes in foreign exchange rates". Position: milieu Item 1A.
risks.summary: Environmental regulations, climate-related legislation, and tax law changes (including OBBBA provisions effective after 2025) create compliance and profitability risks.

risks.title: Decline in new construction activity
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly cited as risk factor. MD&A indicates replacement business is 'substantial portion' but new construction highly cyclical and interest-rate sensitive. Citation: "In addition to weather, demand for our products and services is influenced by national and". Position: haut Item 1A.
risks.summary: Downturn in residential and commercial construction activity directly reduces demand for new HVACR systems and related services.

risks.title: Impact of weather on business
risks.score_rationale: MD&A notes demand is 'seasonal and significantly impacted by weather.' Warmer/cooler than normal temperatures directly affect replacement product demand. Citation: "The demand for our products and services is seasonal and can be significantly impacted by". Position: haut Item 1A.
risks.summary: Unusual weather patterns (warmer summers, milder winters) reduce demand for replacement heating and cooling products.

risks.title: Trade tariffs and international operations risks
risks.score_rationale: Listed as forward-looking risk. New or increased trade tariffs could affect manufacturing costs and international competitiveness. Citation: "Foreign currency exchange losses increased in 2024 primarily due to changes in foreign exchange rates". Position: milieu Item 1A.
risks.summary: Trade tariff increases and international operational challenges including foreign exchange exposure affect cost structure and margins.

company_description: Lennox International Inc., together with its subsidiaries, designs, manufactures, and markets products for the heating, ventilation, air conditioning, and refrigeration markets in the United States, Canada, and internationally. The Home Comfort Solutions segment provides furnaces, air conditioners, heat pumps, packaged heating and cooling systems, indoor air quality equipment, comfort control products, and replacement parts and supplies; residential heating, ventilation, cooling equipment, and air conditioning; and evaporator coils, air handlers, and unit heaters under Lennox, Dave Lennox Signature Collection, Armstrong Air, Ducane, AirEase, Concord, MagicPak, Advanced Distributor Products, Allied, Elite Series, Supco, Linebacker, Elite series, Merit Series, Comfort Sync, Healthy Climate, Healthy Climate Solutions, iComfort, ComfortSense, and Lennox Stores name. The Building Climate Solutions segment offers unitary heating and air conditioning equipment, controls, installation and service of commercial heating and cooling equipment, variable refrigerant flow commercial, curb, curb adapters, drop box diffusers, HVAC recycling, and salvage service.
